> **Note**
>
> **What you'll achieve**
> By the end of this guide, you will have retrieved documents from your TerminusDB database using the JavaScript client, the Python client, or the HTTP API.

> **Prerequisite:** this guide assumes a TerminusDB instance and the example database used throughout the TerminusDB docs (see the live page for the clone snippet).

## Get a single document

Retrieve a document by its ID:

```typescript
const getDoc = async () => {
  const doc = await client.getDocument({ id: "Player/Doug" })
  console.log("Player/Doug:", doc)
}
```

Returns:

```json
{
  "@id"   : "Player/Doug",
  "@type" : "Player",
  "name"    : "Doug",
  "position": "Full Back"
}
```

```python
document = client.get_document("Player/Doug")
```

Returns:

```json
{
  "@id"   : "Player/Doug",
  "@type" : "Player",
  "name"    : "Doug",
  "position": "Full Back"
}
```

```bash
curl -u admin:root \
  "http://localhost:6363/api/document/admin/tdb-example-mydb/local/branch/main?id=Player/Doug"
```

Returns:

```json
{
  "@id"   : "Player/Doug",
  "@type" : "Player",
  "name"    : "Doug",
  "position": "Full Back"
}
```

## Get all documents

Retrieve every document in the database:

```typescript
const getDocs = async () => {
  const documents = await client.getDocument({ as_list: "true" })
  console.log("All documents:", documents)
}
```

Returns:

```json
[
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/Doug",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "Doug",
    "position": "Full Back"
  },
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/George",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "George",
    "position": "Center Back"
  },
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/Karen",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "Karen",
    "position": "Center Forward"
  }
]
```

```python
documents = list(client.get_all_documents())
```

`get_all_documents` returns a generator — wrap it with `list()` if you need to iterate more than once.

```json
[
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/Doug",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "Doug",
    "position": "Full Back"
  },
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/George",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "George",
    "position": "Center Back"
  },
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/Karen",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "Karen",
    "position": "Center Forward"
  }
]
```

```bash
curl -u admin:root \
  "http://localhost:6363/api/document/admin/tdb-example-mydb/local/branch/main?as_list=true"
```

Returns:

```json
[
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/Doug",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "Doug",
    "position": "Full Back"
  },
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/George",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "George",
    "position": "Center Back"
  },
  {
    "@id"   : "Player/Karen",
    "@type" : "Player",
    "name"    : "Karen",
    "position": "Center Forward"
  }
]
```

## Next steps

You've retrieved documents from TerminusDB. Next, you might want to:

- [**Edit documents**](https://terminusdb.org/docs/edit-a-document/) — update the documents you just fetched
- [**Query with WOQL**](https://terminusdb.org/docs/run-woql-query/) — use pattern-matching queries for complex filtering
- [**Delete documents**](https://terminusdb.org/docs/delete-a-document/) — remove documents you no longer need
